title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Confirms New U.S. Streaming Platform Ahead of Premiere
content:
Dragon Ball Super is set to finally make its highly anticipated return to screens this Fall, and the new remake series has confirmed another major streaming home where fans will be able to check it out. This weekend will see Dragon Ball Super finally kick off its return as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule with a newly enhanced version of the original TV anime series. It’s been over ten years since that anime first made its own debut, and all these years later it’s going to look and sound better than ever.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is an enhanced version of the original Dragon Ball Super TV anime series that will feature new visuals, sound effects, music and more beginning with the Battle of Gods arc. Making its official debut on October 11th in Japan , Hulu has now confirmed via press release that they will also be streaming the series alongside the episodes hitting in Japan. This makes it even easier to check out than ever before, and fans are going to want to keep an eye out for it.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Confirms Hulu Release Date

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be officially streaming with Hulu in the United States alongside its debut in Japan on Sunday, October 11th. This will be the Japanese language release with English subtitles, but an English dub release has yet to be announced for any streaming platform. Along with its upcoming release on Hulu, the new remake series will also be available for streaming with Crunchyroll , and then will be made available for streaming with Netflix beginning on October 17th. That helps to further emphasize just how big of a deal this comeback really is.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is set to go all the way back to the beginning of the original TV anime series with an enhanced version of the Battle of Gods, Resurrection F, and Universe 6 arcs. Toei Animation has been teasing that the remake series will feature “extensive new cuts, revisions to existing scenes, a complete re-rendering of all footage, newly recorded dubbing with added score and sound effects, and a full reconstruction of the story.” But at this time, it’s yet to be made clear the extent of how much will actually change from that original experience.

What’s Next for Dragon Ball Super?

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has also yet to reveal how many episodes it’s going to be running for, nor has it revealed whether or not future arcs will also get this new remake treatment. It’s something to keep an eye out for through the rest of the year too as Dragon Ball Super has another big project now in the works for the future. Because while the anime is coming back for this new remake, it’s also now working on a brand new anime that will finally be adapting the manga arcs that have yet to get their due.

Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol is a brand new anime series adapting the Galactic Patrol Prisoner arc from the manga release. This arc introduces a brand new anime yet to be seen in anime , but has unfortunately also yet to reveal a release window or date as of this time. With so much in the works, Dragon Ball Super is ready to takeover screens once more. Are you excited for the new Dragon Ball Super remake? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Shonen Jump’s Smartest Anime to Return With New Sequel – Watch First Look Trailer
content:
The smartest anime franchise to ever come out of the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has confirmed it’s coming back to screens with a new sequel anime with a first look revealed at what’s next. It’s been a big couple of years for Shonen Jump as many of their longest running hits have come to an end in the magazine. But it’s also been an end of an era for many of their longer running anime adaptations too as some big franchises have released their respective final episodes .

The anime adaptation for Riichiro Inagaki and Boichi’s Dr. Stone officially came to an end this year after seven years of running on the air , but thankfully it has now been confirmed that there’s even more of the anime on the way. During a special event for the franchise in Japan over the weekend, Dr. Stone has announced it’s returning for a new sequel anime release, Dr. Stone Terraforming . Check out the announcement trailer for the new sequel in action below.

Dr. Stone Terraforming Sequel Anime Announced

Dr. Stone Terraforming has been announced as an official sequel anime to the TV series produced by Toho Animation. A release window or date has yet to be announced for the new anime as of this time, but it will be taking place after the events of the original TV series. It will also be adapting the official epilogue manga materials that Inagaki and Boichi had returned with following the end of the original series. Which ultimately does raise a lot of questions about what kind of form this new sequel anime project will take upon its release.

Dr. Stone Terraforming was an official one-shot chapter that came a few months after the original manga ending of the series. This one-shot was just another fun outing with Senku following an experiment that left him stranded out in the middle of nowhere, but unfortunately doesn’t follow up the final cliffhanger seen in the actual finale of the series . If this new sequel is going to be adapting its single chapter namesake, it might not be running for too long. But either way, this is a cool thing to see for fans of the original Dr. Stone TV anime series.

How Does Dr. Stone End?

Dr. Stone officially wrapped up its seven year long run with its final episodes earlier this year, and with it saw Senku and the others figuring out what ultimately turned the Earth to stone in the first place all those years ago . The final villain made a lot of sense for the scientific focus of the series, and that led to a finale that teased there would be much more in the future for Senku and the others as they continued to advance their technologies even further from that point on.

It was one of the better received endings to Shonen Jump anime franchises , so it makes all the sense in the world to see it return for this new sequel anime release. Production staff, potential returning voice cast and more have yet to be revealed for this new project, but it’s certainly exciting either way. Are you down to see more of Dr. Stone ‘s anime? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: New 'Dr. Stone' Anime Announced
content:
The Stone Fes.2026 event at Yokohama Buntai announced on Saturday that a sequel anime subtitled Dr. Stone: Terraforming is in production. The official website also revealed a new anime logo (pictured above) and an announcement promo.

The new anime will adapt the Terraforming one-shot episode included on volume 27 of the original manga. The story is set after the conclusion of the main series and the final episode of Dr. Stone: Science Future , which aired in June 2025.

Produced by TMS Entertainment , the first anime season premiered in 24 episodes in Summer 2019, followed by the 11-episode second season Stone Wars in Winter 2021, and a special episode Ryuusui in July 2022. The third season New World aired in two parts, the first 11 episodes in Spring 2023, with the second part aired in Fall 2023. The fourth and final season Science Future aired in three split cours from January 2025 to June 25, 2026. Crunchyroll streamed the anime series with English subtitles and dubs worldwide, excluding Asia.

Dr. Stone adapts Riichiro Inagaki and Boichi 's post-apocalyptic adventure sci-fi manga , which ran in Weekly Shounen Jump from March 2017 to March 2022. Shueisha published the 27th volume, which includes the Terraforming one-shot, in April 2024.

A nine-chapter side story , titled Dr. Stone Reboot: Byakuya , was serialized in the same magazine from October to December in 2019. The manga has a cumulative 20 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English and shipped the 27th and final volume in June 2025. Shueisha is also releasing the manga and side story digitally in English on its Manga Plus platform.

The manga won the 64th Shogakukan Manga Award in the shounen category in 2019. It ranked second in the comic category of the 2018 Next Manga Awards, was selected as a Jury Recommended Work in the Manga Division at the 21st Japan Media Arts Festival, and was nominated for the 54th Seiun Award in the Best Comic category in 2023.

Announcement

title: Millennium Family TV Anime Casts Taihi Kimura
content:
The staff for the television anime of Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga announced on Saturday that Taihi Kimura voices Noel, the third son of the Benfield family.

The anime will air on TBS and other stations.

The anime will star:

• Rikuya Yasuda as Theo

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Hayden

• Ryōta Suzuki as Hugo

• Lynn as Eve

Masato Jinbo ( Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya 2wei! /2wei Herz!/3rei!! , Chaos;Child , The Rising of The Shield Hero Season 2 ) is directing the anime at PartsCraft , and is also supervising the scripts. Hiroshi Yoneda ( Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya: Vow in the Snow ) is the character designer and chief animation director.

AI localization company Orange Inc. 's e-bookstore service emaqi licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Seven immortal siblings born in England possess humanity's ultimate dream: eternal life. But their gift makes them targets for the criminal underworld, corrupt hospitals, and international military organizations! After centuries apart, this extraordinary family reunites for a thrilling new chapter in their lives.

Kasugai launched the manga in Shōnengahōsha 's Young King Ours magazine in March 2021. Shōnengahōsha released the manga's ninth compiled book volume on July 30.

title: Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING Sequel Anime Announced
content:
A new Dr. STONE sequel anime titled Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING is officially in production. The project will continue the story after the conclusion of the TV anime , which premiered its series finale on June 25, 2026.

The new anime will adapt “TERRAFORMING,” a sequel story included in Volume 27 of the original manga. An announcement trailer featuring newly recorded dialogue from Senku was also released.

The manga’s author Riichiro Inagaki shared a comment:

“Thank you to everyone watching STONE FES. 2026! The Dr. STONE anime actually made it all the way to the final chapter of the original manga. I was deeply moved. And yet, somehow! There’s still more…!! It wasn’t a lie! After all, Senku and the others’ scientific adventure was still continuing. Actually, that kind of lie is more than welcome! You can even say this finale event being the finale was a lie too! So everyone, please watch over Senku and the others’ science for just a little while longer. This is insanely exhilarating!!”

Manga artist Boichi also commented:

“To everyone attending STONE FES. 2026, everyone watching the stream, and everyone who has watched the Dr. STONE anime, thank you so much as always! I’m truly happy that we can share the joy of the news that the Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING anime is being produced. Please look forward to further updates!”

TV anime character designer Yuko Iwasa also drew a commemorative illustration for the announcement:

Riichiro Inagaki wrote the Dr. STONE manga, with art by Boichi. The series ended after 5 years of serialization on March 7, 2022 with a total of 232 chapters. The creators shared a special illustration and messages:

The Dr. STONE a nime adaptation began airing in July 2019, with its first season running for 24 episodes. It was followed by Dr. STONE: STONE WARS in January 2021, an 11-episode second season focused on the conflict between the Kingdom of Science and Tsukasa’s Empire of Might. The series then received the Dr. STONE: Ryusui special in July 2022, which introduced Ryusui Nanami.

The third season, Dr. STONE: NEW WORLD , aired across two split cours in 2023 and covered the Treasure Island arc . Immediately after its finale, the fourth and final season, Dr. STONE: SCIENCE FUTURE , was announced. The final season aired over three split cours from 2025 to 2026, concluding the anime adaptation on June 25, 2026 and bringing Senku’s story, the mystery of petrification, and the Kingdom of Science’s journey to their end.

The adaptation has a total of four seasons and one special: 24 episodes in Season 1, 11 in Season 2, the Ryusui special, 22 in Season 3, and 37 in Season 4, coming up to 94 regular TV episodes plus one special, or 95 animated episodes total.

title: 'I am the only one who is not attacked in the world filled with zombies' TV Anime's Main Promo Video Previews Theme Songs
content:
The official website for the television anime of Rokuro Uraji 's I am the only one who is not attacked in the world filled with zombies . ( Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore Dake ga Osowarenai ) novel series revealed the show's main promotional video, key visual, additional cast, and theme song information on Saturday.

RetBear performs the opening theme song "No Reaction," and Itsuka▶ (Itsuka Saisei) performs the ending theme song "Tsukikage" (Moonlight). The above video previews both songs.

The new cast members include:

Rikako Ito as Tokiko Kurose

Marie Miyake as Sayaka Makiura

The anime will debut in January 2027 and will air on the premium AT-X channel.

The series will star Wataru Katō as Yūsuke Takemura and Yuno Azuma as Mitsuki Fujino.

Kazuya Fujishiro ( Dropkick on My Devil! , Girlfriend, Girlfriend , Cells at Work! Code Black episode director) is directing the anime at acca effe and Frontier Engine . Yasushi Hirano ( City Hunter , The Brave Fighter of Legend Da-Garn ) is in charge of the series scripts, Kayo Shimoyama and Makuto Okimiru are writing the scripts, and Megumi Ishihara ( Fate/stay night , Fortune Arterial: Akai Yakusoku ) is designing the characters. Tadashi Jinbo (2026 High School! Kimengumi , Uma Yuru ) is the sound director at Bisei , and ISAO is composing the music at Frontier Works .

The anime was previously announced to debut this year.

The "zombie panic action" story takes place in a world that is suddenly flooded with zombies, and for some reason the protagonist Takemura is the only person the zombies do not attack. If this were a zombie movie, Takemura would use this ability to fight against the zombies, but instead he just acts according to his desires.

Uraji launched the story on the R18 version of the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in January 2013 and ended the story in 2017. Frontier Works published three volumes for the series with illustrations by Saburō in 2016 to 2017.

Chihiro Masuda launched a manga adaptation in June 2021, and Frontier Works released the fifth manga volume on August 5. Robo Kondō launched a spinoff manga titled Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore Dake ga Osowarenai Tokiko IF STORY on the Comic CMOA website in October 2025. The spinoff manga's first volume also shipped on August 5.

title: 'Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore dake ga Osowarenai' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, First Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Rokuro Uraji 's Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore dake ga Osowarenai ( In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked ) light novel unveiled additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and first promotional video on Saturday. The anime series will premiere on AT-X in January 2027.

Voice actresses Rikako Itou ( Mushoku no Eiyuu ) and Marie Miyake ( Gin no Saji ) are joining the casts as Tokiko Kurose and Sayaka Makiura, respectively.

Staff Art Design: Ami Takasusuki ( Saikyou no Shienshoku "Wajutsushi" de Aru Ore wa Sekai Saikyou Clan wo Shitagaeru ), You Shinomiya , Recommendation Art Director: Shinji Katahira ( Nakanohito Genome [Jikkyouchuu] ), Shinobu Takahashi ( "Kimi wo Aisuru Ki wa Nai" to Itta Jiki Koushaku-sama ga Nazeka Dekiai shitekimasu ) Color Design: Shinobu Hirayama Director of Photography: Yuuki Sakurai (Rare Trick) Editing: Kouki Shinkai ( Peter Grill to Kenja no Jikan )

Music group RetBear ( Kuro no Shoukanshi ) is performing the opening theme "No Reaction." Japanese idol group Itsuka▶ is performing the ending theme "Tsukikage." Both theme songs are previewed in the first promotional video below.

Kazuya Fujishiro ( Haishin Yuusha ) is directing the anime at Acca effe and Frontier Engine , with Yasushi Hirano ( City Hunter ) handling the series composition, assisted by Kayou Shimoyama . Shimoyama and Rumakuto Okimi are penning the script. Yoshiharu Ishihara ( Fortune Arterial ) is designing the characters, and ISAO ( bloodivores ) is composing the music.

Rokuro began penning the supernatural horror novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in January 2013. Frontier Works later acquired the series and began publishing the title under its Nox Novels label in February 2016, featuring illustrations by Saburou . The third volume went on sale in March 2017.

Chihiro Matsuda began drawing a manga adaptation on the Comic Ragchew web service in March 2022. NTT Solmare began publishing the manga adaptation on its MangaPlaza web service and app in September 2024, followed by the release of the fifth volume on August 5.

Robo Kondo launched a spin-off manga on the same website in October 2025. The first volume went on sale on August 5.

title: Billy Bat Manga Wins Harvey Award
content:
The Harvey Awards, which honor outstanding work in comics and sequential art, announced the winners for this year's awards on Friday at New York Comic Con . Naoki Urasawa and Takashi Nagasaki 's Billy Bat manga, released by Abrams ComicArts ' Kana imprint, won the award for Best Manga. Kristi Iwashiro translates the manga.

The other nominees in the category included:

• He Rolled Me Up Like a Grilled Squid by Yoshiharu Tsuge (Drawn & Quarterly, translated by Ryan Holmberg)

• Land by Kazumi Yamashita (Yen Press, translated by Kevin Gifford)

• Miss Ruki by Fumiko Takano (New York Review Comics, translated by Alexa Frank)

• My Gorilla Family by Ichiro Iijima (Living the Line, translated by Ryan Holmberg)

• My Life in 24 Frames per Second by Rintarō (Kana/Abrams ComicArts, translated by Montana Kane)

Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc , Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle - Akaza Sairai , My Hero Academia — Final Season , the One Piece: Into the Grand Line live-action season, and the Korean animated film Your Letter were nominated for Best Adaptation from Comic Book/Graphic Novel category. However, Spider-Noir won the award.

Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier won the Best Manga award last year.

The Harvey Awards added the Best Manga category in 2018. Kabi Nagata 's My Lesbian Experience with Loneliness manga won the first award in this category. Kōhei Horikoshi 's My Hero Academia won the award in 2019, and Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier won the award in 2020. Tatsuki Fujimoto 's Chainsaw Man won the award in 2021, 2022, and 2023. Ryōko Kui 's Delicious in Dungeon won the award in 2024.

In previous years, manga were nominated alongside other comics in the "Best American Edition of Foreign Material" category. The last manga to win the category was Hajime Isayama 's Attack on Titan in 2014. One-Punch Man and Showa: A History of Japan (1953-1989) were nominated in 2016 but did not win. "Best American Edition of Foreign Material" is no longer a category.

Unlike the Eisner Awards and other awards in the North American comic book industry, the Harvey Awards are nominated and selected by the comic book professionals themselves.
